notepad_final:
Level 1:
- Top: 12 selected movable cover/blank; arrows slide 1 tile and reveal underlying tile; clicking visible pieces swaps/selects; clicking 8 treats it as background/target and moves 12 onto it without removing 8.
- Bottom: clicking a 1 selects it as 14; arrows slide 14 and reveal underlying tiles; bottom 7 acts like top 8 background/target.
- Right 1 sits on hidden 1. Left home initially showed 11, but after reselection/clean reset often reveals 1 instead, so hidden state can reset/change.
- Clicking a bottom 1 while top 12 is visible switches control to bottom. Clicking a top 11 while bottom was active can reactivate top, but top-right 11 from an altered state caused a broad reset-like return to the original top-only 3/8 palette; reset recovers more reliably than undo.
- Clean reset re-entry baseline: select alone showed no visible change, but clicking the familiar bottom-left 1 reliably re-entered the bottom puzzle.
- Clean re-entry movement: first right revealed 1 under left home; second right revealed 5 under x24-27; moving onto/off central 7 showed 7 is revealed underneath; continuing right revealed ordinary path.
- Repeated rights on the far-right stretch eventually changed the top HUD from 3/8 to 7/4 without immediately resetting the bottom 14, so HUD changes can occur while 14 still remains on the far-right edge.
- In the 7/4 phase, each extra right shrank the visible top-left block by about one cell while bottom 14 still looked stuck at the edge, suggesting offscreen movement/counter behavior.
- After that shrinking 7/4 phase, the HUD changed into a 2/7-like phase (top row 2s, second row 7s), and continued rights there also affected the visible left segment while bottom 14 stayed pinned at the far-right edge.
- Major observation: the prolonged rightward probe eventually hit the true boundary/teleport. The anomalous HUD returned to normal 3/8, the bottom far-right 14 disappeared, and a selected 14 block relocated near the upper 11 structures.
- Upper teleport branch: right moves can continue to slide the selected 14 through the upper region around the 11 structures without an immediate reset. Once upper 14 reaches the visible far-right edge, further rights leave 14 visually pinned while the top HUD enters an offscreen-counter sequence too.
- Newest observation: the upper far-right offscreen-counter has advanced into a 7/4 HUD phase (top row 7s, second row 4s), and continued rights seem to shrink that 7/4 block leftward by about one cell while upper 14 remains visually pinned. Keep probing right until a teleport/reset or another palette/size change occurs.
- Latest: upper 7/4 shrink phase is still continuing one cell per extra right while 14 stays pinned; no new transition yet.

Gameplay area below HUD. 14 is movable 4x4 overlay/cursor moving in 4-cell steps; leaving reveals underlying tile. Terrain 1/5/7 seem passable. Staircases (11) are special. In original 3/8, select at upper-right staircase changes 14->12 and that staircase 11->8. Carrying 12 to left staircase: right there changes HUD 3/8->7/4; selecting there seems to move across and revert to 14. In 7/4, select at corresponding right-stair setup changes HUD to 2/7 and returns to 12-state. In 2/7, selecting at right-stair setup while 12 restores left staircase 8->11 and changes 12->14; another select from blocked/aligned 14-state resets to 3/8. In reset 3/8, left staircase showed no visible reaction to select, and plain 14-state immediately left of it seemed blocked on right attempts. Hidden route: routing down/left from left-stair area reached a lower central path; continuing down flipped 3/8->7/4 without staircase select. Further hidden-branch travel later showed movement-based state cycling: leftward travel on the hidden branch in 7/4 flipped HUD to 2/7; rightward backtracking in 2/7 flipped back to 3/8, all without select. Select at the far-left blocked end in 2/7 had no visible effect. Vacated branch cells reveal as 0, so 0 may be traversable on this hidden branch. The hidden branch reconnects/wraps into the upper staircase rows. Continued rightward travel led to a far-right dead-end/re-entry area in 3/8; select/left/down/up there showed no visible effect. Undoing from that dead end rewound HUD/history through 7/4 to 2/7 while leaving the overlay at the same far-right area. Left from the far-right point in 2/7 is traversable and shifts the overlay inward. Select from that inward 2/7 point still showed no visible effect; next test is to move left closer to or onto the visible right staircase block.

L1: click selects pieces; arrows move selected pieces in 4-cell steps. Select toggles/commits visual states (12<->14 and header/global 5/2, 7/4, 3/8), so avoid unless specifically testing. Undo restores earlier layouts. Safe recovery: from header-wide rollback states, undo until the ambiguous upper staircase view returns, then re-click near the staircase to re-establish focus. Best staircase refocus tests so far: 38,17 often loops; adjacent cells can flip the header to a 2/7-style state while keeping the upper 11 source and upper solid 12 block visible. Working route from the clean upper-staircase state is down, right, down, down toward the lower-right target. If a solid 12 block appears in the lower strip while 11 remains above, that is after the first down; if it shifts right in the lower strip, next move is down; if it reaches the far-right lower area, continue down. New observation: click 37,18 changed the board from the 7/4 rollback view to a 2/7-style header with upper 11/12 still visible; from that restored-looking state, try down.
